die([name, orderRuleMessage('known-rule', { violation: 'known-violation' }), renderOrderHeaderHelp(agent)].join('\n'));
die(orderRuleMessage('known-rule') + orderDiagnosticMessage('known-diagnostic'));
const message = [name, orderRuleMessage('known-rule')].join(' ');
die(message);
const refuse = message => die(message);
refuse(orderRuleMessage('known-rule') + renderOrderHeaderHelp(agent));
